info.title: Ariadne.NET.Cli
info.description: The ariadne command: checks a .NET solution against its Ariadne.NET architecture rule packs, sets up a repository's rules and runs the Claude Code hooks.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize architecture rules for this project

options.name: --template
options.description: Template to initialize (supports + for composition, e.g. clean-architecture+cqrs) [default: clean-architecture]

options.name: --agent
options.description: Also install the hooks for a coding agent (accepted value: claude)

commands.name: roles
commands.description: Print component roles from resolved rules

options.name: --role
options.description: Component role to generate (e.g. Entity, Repository)

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the component to generate (e.g. Order)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a solution or project against every pack under .architecture/

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format: text, json or sarif [default: text]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to this file instead of standard output; its folder is created when missing

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to a .sln, .slnx, .slnf or .csproj, or a directory holding exactly one [default: .]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Sync rule packs from git repositories defined in imports.yaml

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Force fresh sync, ignore cached versions [default: False]

options.name: --name
options.description: Sync only the import with this name

commands.name: hook
commands.description: Run an agent hook for Claude Code; reads the hook input on stdin

arguments.name: EVENT
arguments.description: The hook event: session-start, pre-tool-use or stop
